description: This Java class implements the 'default' function for a pipeline, providing default values for unresolved placeholders within a processing pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDefault
classes.description: Implements the default value function for pipeline processing, handling default value resolution.

classes.name: DefaultFunctionSignature
classes.description: Defines the signature for the default function, including parameter definitions.

classes.name: DefaultValueParam
classes.description: Describes the default value parameter for the default function.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, 'default'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature object for the default function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the default function to a pipeline element, resolving the default value if the original is unresolved.

methods.name: parseAndResolveThrow
methods.description: Parses and resolves the default value parameter, throwing an exception if resolution fails.
